Risk Description: Out-of-memory crash under parallel workers on 16GB host
Mitigation Strategy: Cap workers at 6, enforce psutil monitor, reduce parallelism if free RAM < 2GB

Risk Description: Public calibration dataset (Zenodo) network timeout or rate limit
Mitigation Strategy: Try 3 retrieval methods; fallback to documented UNCALIBRATED parameter bounds

Risk Description: Simulator execution speed < 1,000 exp/min at scale 100
Mitigation Strategy: Vectorize discrete-time propagation with NumPy; batch graph updates

Risk Description: Reward hacking: agent triggers repeated catastrophic damage for reward
Mitigation Strategy: R2 incorporates explicit damage penalty and repeat penalty; verified with damage probe

Risk Description: Hidden ground-truth weakness leaks into observation vector
Mitigation Strategy: Automated leak test in pytest asserting observation vectors never correlate with planted weakness bitmask

Risk Description: Heuristic expert solves all weaknesses due to trivial topology
Mitigation Strategy: Add well-protected hub decoys and fragile low-degree leaves to generator

Risk Description: PPO training instability (policy collapse or exploding gradient)
Mitigation Strategy: Apply gradient clipping (0.5), GAE advantage normalization, and automated tuning playbook

Risk Description: Ensemble E3 overfits to validation systems
Mitigation Strategy: Cross-validation across systems; freeze model hashes before final evaluation

Risk Description: Test set contamination or early snooping
Mitigation Strategy: Strict code lock requiring CHAOSRL_FINAL_TEST=1 and logging access to test_access_log.csv

Risk Description: Host machine sleep or throttling during overnight run
Mitigation Strategy: Hourly heartbeat to results/heartbeat.json and automatic resumption command
